detail.longDescription: Situated along the state’s Blue Ridge Parkway, NC45 is one of the sites of the National Atmospheric Deposition Program (NADP), the only long-term deposition monitoring program at a national scale. The program studies substances deposited from the atmosphere onto land and water. https://www. thexylom.com/post/this-nationa l-program-asks-whats-in-our-air-and-water/ # northcarolina # environment # research # news
